info.title: AquaTome fish ID
info.description:
A reader's photo → Claude's guesses → the handbook's pages for them, for the site's tool (/vi/cong-cu/nhan-dien-ca/) and the iOS app (apps/site/worker/fishid/api.ts).

GET says whether the tool is on, and its daily limits.

POST comes one of two ways:
- The site's page: same-origin (`Origin`), with a Turnstile `token`. Counted per address: `perIp` a day.
- The app: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, the token a sign-in with client "app" returns (protocols/accounts.openapi.json), checked as GET /api/v1/session checks it. No Origin and no Turnstile. Counted per account (`perAccount` a day, kept 24 h), not per address: many phones share one carrier address. A bearer that is present but missing, expired or signed out is `401 {error: "session"}`, even with a `token` too: it never falls back to the page's way.

Every identification also counts against the site's day (`busy` past it).

The photo: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 1.5 MB. Send it shrunk (the page sends a JPEG of 1024 px at most) and without its metadata (location, camera). It goes to Claude, Anthropic's model, and is not logged; the log keeps counts, timings, the model, tokens and keys by hash only.

Keeping (the reader's opt-in, one per photo, unticked by default: "Cho phép AquaTome giữ ảnh này để cải thiện nhận diện"): with `keep`, a JPEG is kept with its result for 6 months, private (only the site's admins see it), its own metadata cut, then deleted. It is kept under the account that sent it (the app's bearer, or the page's signed-in cookie), or, sent signed out, tied to no one. The answer then says `kept`: false when it wasn't (not a JPEG, or storage unavailable); the identification stands either way. Without `keep`, nothing is stored and the answer has no `kept`. The account lists and deletes its kept photos with GET /api/v1/fish-id/photos and DELETE /api/v1/fish-id/photos/{id} (protocols/accounts.openapi.json); they go when the account is deleted.

Our own copies (a user agent with `AquaTomeCheck/1`) are answered as anyone's, but their guesses add no wanted names.

Errors are `{error}`; the app shows each with the site's own words for it (apps/site/src/scripts/fish-id.ts).

get.summary: Whether the tool is on, and its limits

post.summary: Identify the fish or plant in a photo

200.description: Claude's guesses, each with the handbook's pages for it

429.description: Error: rate (the reader's day is used up: `limit` says how many it has) | busy (the site's day is)

bearer.description: The app: the token from a sign-in with client "app" (protocols/accounts.openapi.json).

Status.description: {on: false} when the tool is off; otherwise its Turnstile site key (the page's way), whether every key is resting, and the daily limits.

resting.description: Every key is set aside for now: an identification would answer 503 resting.

perIp.description: Identifications a day for an address (the page's way).

perAccount.description: Identifications a day for an account (the app's way).

file.description: The photo, shrunk and without its metadata.

lang.description: The reader's language: the reasons' language and the pages' addresses. vi when missing.

from.description: Where the reader started: the tool's page, or a tank's "identify by photo" button. For the owner's log only.

token.description: Turnstile's token: the page's way only.

keep.description: The reader ticked the opt-in for this photo: keep it with its result for 6 months. Leave it out otherwise.

image.description: The photo as base64 (a data: URL's prefix is ignored).

keep.description: true: the reader ticked the opt-in for this photo. Leave it out otherwise.

verdict.description: other: no fish or plant in the photo (no results); unclear: one is there but can't be told.

refused.description: Claude declined to answer: verdict unclear, no results.

kept.description: Only when `keep` was sent: whether the photo was kept.

variety.description: A bred form ("Halfmoon"), when Claude sees one.

reason.description: What in the photo points to it, in the reader's language.

page.description: The handbook's page for it: the breed its variety names, else the species or plant.

species.description: The species beside a breed's page.

sameGenus.description: The genus's other species and plant pages, for "not this one?". Never a match.

url.description: The page's address in the reader's language, when it has one there.

limit.description: With rate: the reader's limit a day.
